key_semantics: disable_auto sets auto_exposure=false and auto_white_balance=false on target camera driver
enable_auto sets auto_exposure=true and auto_white_balance=true on target camera driver
uses ROS2 parameter mechanism rather than ROS1 dynamic_reconfigure

evaluation.notes: Oracle focuses on semantic signals and interface-level migration constraints rather than exact formatting.

description: Migrate a ROS1 dynamic_reconfigure-based camera configuration client to ROS2 using parameter-based configuration while preserving target namespace and enable/disable semantics.
